title: Shift 0.05 of scoring weight from sentiment to technical
why: sentiment has agreed with actual price direction 28% of the time over 18 measured calls, vs. technical's 45% over 29.
effect: Confidence scores lean slightly more on technical and less on sentiment.
risk: Scoring weights were last changed on 2026-10-06 (4 day(s) ago): Shift 0.05 of scoring weight from catalyst to technical. The hit rates behind this proposal have had little time to change, so consider waiting.

title: Raise the stale-price limit from 4% to 5%
why: 54 of 67 logged auto-apply refusals (81%; 11 of the last 30 days, since 2026-09-30) were blocked because the price or signal moved between scoring and submission.
effect: Orders whose price moved up to 5% since scoring can go through instead of being refused.
risk: Loosens a guardrail: some of those blocked orders would have lost money (see 'Opportunities lost or avoided'). The technical re-check still runs.

title: Keep recommendations approvable for 3h instead of 2h
why: 118 actionable recommendations over the last 30 days expired with no decision recorded.
effect: More time to approve or reject from the email before a recommendation lapses.
risk: An older approval can still execute; the stale-price re-check at submission is what limits how far the market can have moved.
